practices.title: Coverage, source status and app adaptations
practices.text: 8 source activities. Exact explicit keyboard step lists preserve all four sequences. Three rounds of ten are stated after p02: p02 uses that quota; p01 remains open because wider scope is ambiguous. Harmonic quotas are not supplied. Guitar melodic/harmonic doubles retain the stated shared two-rounds-of-twenty assignment in Info/instructions, but remain open because separate-mode scope is unknown. Meditation triples and combined-eight team work retain required manual guidance. Five combined-eight naming forms are OPTIONAL, open app realizations, not prescribed forms or a completion gate. Source status: text_supported_audio_unverified. MIDI spelling uses pitch classes: h/B means B-natural (11), b/B-flat means 10; enharmonic names are not extra tones. Keyboard assessment, finite playback registers, ordering, assistance credit and sampling policies are explicit app adaptations; no physical-instrument or vocal-accuracy grading is claimed. Optional practice never gates class completion.
